; ============================================================================
;  Kalshi-Diagnostic-Limits.json   THROWAWAY — run, read the file, delete.
; ============================================================================
;  Writes results to a FILE rather than the log pane, because the log output
;  was not appearing. Open this after ~15 seconds:
;
;      <NightShark>\lib\LIMITS-RESULT.txt
;
;  Places no orders. Changes nothing.
; ============================================================================

outFile := A_ScriptDir "\LIMITS-RESULT.txt"
FileDelete, %outFile%

W(outFile, "KALSHI RATE LIMIT DIAGNOSTIC")
W(outFile, "started " A_NowUTC)
W(outFile, "script dir: " A_ScriptDir)
W(outFile, "")

paths := ["/trade-api/v2/account/limits"
        , "/trade-api/v2/account"
        , "/trade-api/v2/portfolio/balance"
        , "/trade-api/v2/exchange/status"]

base := "https://api.elections.kalshi.com"

for idx, p in paths {
    W(outFile, "==== GET " p " ====")
    body := ""
    body := HttpGet(base p "?_=" A_TickCount)
    if (body = "") {
        W(outFile, "EMPTY RESPONSE")
        W(outFile, "  -> either unauthenticated, blocked, or endpoint absent")
    } else {
        W(outFile, "LENGTH " StrLen(body))
        W(outFile, body)
    }
    W(outFile, "")
    Sleep 400
}

W(outFile, "==== HOW TO READ THIS ====")
W(outFile, "Look for a WRITE refill rate / writes-per-second value.")
W(outFile, "  <=10/sec : fast maker NOT buildable on this tier")
W(outFile, "  20-30    : marginal, one market only")
W(outFile, "  >=50     : buildable")
W(outFile, "")
W(outFile, "If /portfolio/balance returned data but /account/limits was EMPTY,")
W(outFile, "auth works and the limits endpoint simply is not exposed — in that")
W(outFile, "case the tier has to come from Kalshi directly.")
W(outFile, "")
W(outFile, "If EVERYTHING was empty, HttpGet is not signing requests.")
W(outFile, "DONE " A_NowUTC)

loop {
    LogStream("result", "see LIMITS-RESULT.txt")
    Sleep 30000
}

W(f, s) {
    line := s "`r`n"
    FileAppend, %line%, %f%
    Log(s)
}
